digest.component_or_area: Cloud adapter + DC adapter — Jira reconciler resilience and config-validation parity
propositions: Cloud transport mutations lack explicit per-member 429-handling enumeration across all four retry boundaries (bare urlopen, pooled REST, ACLI subprocess backoff, dispatch-wrapper retry), creating risk of silent retry inheritance by omission.

Cloud has no config-validation tier testing for non-HTTPS base URL rejection, missing-credential loudness, or credential fallback behavior that DC gained through hardening (bug cd78 already demonstrated the silent-fallback risk).

Cloud's probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES without runtime configuration, blocking Cloud deployments with non-standard resolved-status workflow names from correct probe behavior, unlike DC which threads resolved_statuses from settings.
Cloud has no assertion that the DC adapter's user-search method set (none of _USER_SEARCH_METHODS aliases exposed) causes correct degradation to string-match assignment rather than raising.
